bullets: 【Upgraded Support & 4" Thick Sleep Support】 The Pretyw self-inflating camping sleeping pad is made with durable outdoor materials, suitable for all weather conditions. Measuring 79×27.5 inches and inflating to 4 inches thick, it provides superior support and cushioning whether you sleep on your back or on your side, ensuring a restful night outdoors. The built-in pillow adds comfort and convenience, keeping you comfortably off the ground for great sleep.

【30s Inflate & 1s Deflate】Save time and effort! The built-in pump takes 30-60 seconds to fully inflate the camping mat. No need to inflate it with your mouth or an external pump. It deflates in one second. Note: Before inflating, find the deflation valve at the back of the pillow and press it down firmly until both sealing rings are completely pushed in and sealed.

【Ultra Lightweight & Portable】This ultra-light camping air mattress has a compact design and easily folds into a 10X4 inches carry bag that weighs and takes up about as much as a water bottle. Weighing only 1.8 pounds, it can be effortlessly packed into a backpack or suitcase. Perfect for camping, backpacking, traveling, climbing, hiking, and other outdoor activities, as well as for overnight guests at home.

【Tough & Comfy Camping Mat】Our sleeping pad is made from ultra-thick 40D nylon with a multi-layer TPU design, ensuring excellent durability, waterproof performance, and easy cleaning. Plus, the ergonomic pressure-relief wave pattern design provides ultimate comfort, whether you’re lying on your back, side, or stomach. Our inflatable camping mattresses have been quality-inspected, so use them with confidence.

【Risk-Free & Connectable】 Pretyw is committed to your satisfaction. Our camping pad features side buttons, allowing you to easily connect multiple pads together. Combine 2, 3, or more to create a double, triple, or extra-large air mattress – perfect for family and friends, giving everyone more space. Embrace your journey with Pretyw, where every adventure starts with comfort.
